Includes raw substrates, electroless & electro copper via plating chemicals, surface finishing, solder mask, CNC tooling, and personal protective safety equipment.

via_plating_chemicals.process_description: Two-stage through-hole (PTH) metallization process: (1) Electroless copper deposition to create a conductive seed layer on bare drilled hole walls, followed by (2) Acid copper electroplating to build up 20-25µm structural copper.

chemicals.name: Copper Sulfate Pentahydrate (CuSO4 · 5H2O) Crystals
chemicals.role: Primary copper ion source for acid copper electroplating bath and electroless reduction bath
chemicals.bath_concentration: ~200 g/L in acid copper plating tank

chemicals.name: Concentrated Sulfuric Acid (H2SO4 98%)
chemicals.role: Conductivity electrolyte for acid copper electroplating bath and hole cleaning micro-etch
chemicals.bath_concentration: ~50-60 ml/L in acid copper plating tank

chemicals.name: Hydrochloric Acid (HCl 35%)
chemicals.role: Source of trace chloride ions (50-70 ppm) essential for anode dissolution and brightener activity
chemicals.bath_concentration: ~0.1 ml/L in acid copper plating tank

chemicals.name: Sodium Hydroxide (NaOH Caustic Soda Flakes)
chemicals.role: pH adjustment and reducing agent activator in electroless copper plating baths

chemicals.name: Formaldehyde Solution (37% HCHO Formalin)
chemicals.role: Chemical reducing agent to deposit copper metal from copper sulfate without external electric current

chemicals.name: Conductive Colloidal Palladium / Carbon Via Seed Activator
chemicals.role: Catalytic seed layer deposited onto non-conductive bare fiberglass hole walls to initiate electroless copper reduction
chemicals.purity: Colloidal Palladium-Tin Catalyst / Carbon Via Formulation
chemicals.bath_concentration: Diluted 1:10 with demineralized water for hole sensitization

chemicals.name: Acid Copper Electroplating Brightener & Leveler Additive (A & B)
chemicals.role: Organic carrier and brightener additives ensuring ductile, smooth, mirror-finish copper deposition inside high-aspect vias

chemicals.name: Phosphorized Copper Anode Plates (Cu-DHP 0.04-0.06% P)
chemicals.role: Sacrificial copper anode for electroplating tank; phosphorus content prevents sludge and promotes even dissolution
chemicals.package_amount: 2 Plates (200 mm x 100 mm x 3 mm, ~1 kg total)
chemicals.notes: Enclosed in polypropylene anode bags to filter particles

etching_and_surface_finishing.name: Liquid Tin Chemical Plating Solution (Immersion Tin)
etching_and_surface_finishing.role: Electroless tin plating for exposed pads to prevent copper oxidation and ensure solderability
etching_and_surface_finishing.notes: Lead-free RoHS compliant immersion tin surface finish
